text: Three teams agreed on the problem in the last video. Now we turn their audit into one written rule specific enough that a computer -- not just a meeting -- can check it.
A testable definition needs three things: a clear subscription-status rule, an explicit answer for paused and grace-period members, and deduplication so one person never counts as two rows.
The v1 rule: not canceled, paused under thirty days, active through the paid-through date, counted once per member. Marketing's engagement number gets its own honest name instead -- Engaged Member.
Every clause ships with a query someone can run by hand against real dates, so sign-off isn't a guess -- it's something Finance, Marketing, and Product can each verify themselves.
Definition signed, with real example rows checked against it live in the room. Next: deciding exactly which metrics ship first, and which wait.
